<div class="card-body">
'''Sai'torr Kal Fas''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">サイトア・カルファス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦士ではないキャラクター（ドロイドを除く）に配備すると、戦士技能［戦士アイコン］を与える。または戦士に配備すると、戦闘力＋１（「意識操作」カードの影響を受けない）。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">惑星ダークティル出身のサウリンの女性。同族のドロイド商人ハーチェクのボディーガード。サイトアは、それに見合うと判断した者に、戦闘技能を教える。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sai'torr Kal Fas.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a non-warrior character (except a droid) to give that character warrior skill. Or deploy on a warrior for power +1. (Not affected by the ‘Mind Manipulation’ card.)

'''Lore:''' A Saurin woman from the planet Durkteel and bodyguard to the Saurin droid merchant Hrchek. Sai'torr teaches combat skills to those she judges worthy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says she teaches those she judges worthy; the English says those who prove themselves worthy. The Japanese names 意識操作 where the English printing names Alter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sai'torr Kal Fas]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
